download_librivox_audiobooks: download LibriVox audiobooks with metadata, speaker data, and text to an output directory
get_reader_data: parse a LibriVox book page URL to extract chapter names and reader IDs
import_page: import a page of LibriVox books from the API and save zip, metadata, speaker, and text files
get_size_page: fetch the total download size of LibriVox audiobooks on a given API page without downloading
run_download_librivox_cli: run the CLI to download LibriVox audiobooks with language filter, size limit, and offset options
